name: JetBlue Business Card

apr.notes: APR for purchases: 19.49% to 29.49% variable based on creditworthiness. APR for balance transfers: 19.49% to 29.49%. APR for cash advances: 29.74%. APRs vary with the market based on the Prime Rate. Balance transfer fee: Either $5 or 3% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater.

fx_fee.notes: Page states 'No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.'

categories.label: 2X points at restaurants and office supply stores

rewards.redemption_notes: Points never expire. No blackout dates — any seat, any time on JetBlue-operated flights. Points pooling with family and friends. Cash + Points starting from as few as 500 points.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 50,000 bonus points after spending $4,000 on purchases and paying the annual fee in full, both within the first 90 days.

benefits.title: Free First Checked Bag
benefits.description: Free first checked bag for the primary cardmember and up to 3 eligible travel companions on the same itinerary when you use your JetBlue Business Card on JetBlue-operated flights.

benefits.title: 5,000 Bonus Points Each Anniversary
benefits.description: Earn 5,000 bonus points each year after your JetBlue Business Card account anniversary.

benefits.title: 50% Savings on Inflight Purchases
benefits.description: 50% savings on eligible inflight purchases on JetBlue-operated flights.

benefits.title: 10% of Points Back on Award Flights
benefits.description: Get 10% of your points back after you redeem for and travel on a JetBlue-operated Award Flight.

benefits.title: Group 3 Boarding
benefits.description: Group 3 boarding on JetBlue-operated flights for the primary cardmember and up to 4 eligible travel companions.

benefits.title: $100 JetBlue Vacations Statement Credit
benefits.description: Receive a $100 statement credit after you purchase a JetBlue Vacations package of $100 or more with your JetBlue Business Card. Limit one statement credit per calendar year.

benefits.title: Mosaic Status Faster
benefits.description: Earn toward Mosaic with every purchase.

benefits.title: Points Never Expire
benefits.description: Your points will be ready whenever you are.

benefits.title: No Blackout Dates
benefits.description: Any seat, any time, on JetBlue-operated flights.

benefits.title: Cash + Points
benefits.description: Pay for your flight with almost any combination of dollars and TrueBlue points – starting with as few as 500 points.

benefits.title: Points Pooling
benefits.description: Earn & share points with family & friends.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability Protection
benefits.description: Means you're not responsible for unauthorized charges.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.

benefits.title: Points Payback
benefits.description: Points Payback allows you to redeem points for a statement credit.
